map.WIFI: 格式标准字段：T=加密类型（WPA/WEP/nopass）、S=SS: WIFI: standard fields: T=encryption (WPA/WEP/nopass), S=SSID, P=password, H=hidden (true/false). When SSID or password contains special chars ; , \ you need not escape manually; most scanner apps recognize them.
map.WPA3 网络可直接用 T:WPA 表示，绝大多数现代设备兼容；老旧设备仅支持: WPA3 networks can use T:WPA directly, compatible with most modern devices; pick WEP only for old devices that support nothing else (but WEP is broken — not recommended for new networks).
map.开放网络（无密码）务必用 T:nopass，写成 T: 留空可能被部分解析器误判: For open networks (no password) always use T:nopass; writing T: empty may be misread as WEP by some parsers.
map.标准格式：WIFI:S:<ssid>;T:WPA;P:<pwd>;H:false: Standard format: WIFI:S:<ssid>;T:WPA;P:<pwd>;H:false;; the phone camera scans to connect without typing the password.
